meta.name: knowledge-capture
meta.description: Automates the recording of user decisions, feedback, and tribal knowledge to ensure project consistency and long-term learning across all development tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动沉淀开发决策与反馈，防止项目知识流失
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队常因决策没留档而重复讨论
copy.tagline_en: Automatically capture development decisions and feedback to prevent knowledge loss
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team often rehashes decisions because they weren't recorded

howto.what: Claude 会把你在开发中做出的决定、反馈和项目经验自动记录到固定的知识文件里。每当你说出一个偏好或决定,它就会在文件中添加一条格式化的记录,并确认保存及说明该决定的影响。
howto.when: 当你说出类似“我更喜欢 X 而不是 Y”或“在这个项目里总是做 Z”等表达明确偏好或决定的语句时触发;适用于所有编码、架构和设计讨论。

say.text: 记下来:以后新代码都用 TypeScript。
say.note: 该决定会被保存到知识捕获文件。

say.text: 我更喜欢用函数组件而不是类组件,记住这点。
say.note: 作为架构偏好自动记录。

say.text: 把这条经验存入知识库:样式统一用 Tailwind。
say.note: 作为 UI/UX 偏好记录。

howto.what_en: Logs user decisions, feedback, and tribal knowledge into a fixed knowledge file. When a preference or decision is stated, it appends a formatted entry and confirms the save with an impact summary.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user states a clear preference or decision, e.g. 'I prefer X over Y' or 'Always do Z in this project'. Applies to all coding, architecture, and design discussions.

say_en.text: Log this: use TypeScript for all new code from now on.
say_en.note: Saved to the knowledge capture file.

say_en.text: Remember I prefer function components over class components.
Add to the knowledge base: style everything with Tailwind.
